data.name: Code01Body
data.value: Save notes, links, and meeting scraps the moment they appear. No forms, no upfront filing — the Inbox catches everything.

data.name: Code02Body
data.value: File items close to action with smart PARA suggestions — project, area, resource, or archive. No deep folder mazes.

data.name: Code03Body
data.value: Highlight what matters, extract action items and decisions, and summarize progressively so notes stay useful for months.

data.name: Code04Body
data.value: Turn stored knowledge into blog posts, reports, specs, and briefs. Knowledge is only valuable when it becomes output.

data.value: Built for every brain

data.name: NdSectionTitle
data.value: Designed for focus — including ADHD & AuDHD brains.

data.name: NdSectionLead
data.value: Working memory shouldn't be a job requirement. Brainy externalizes the remembering, the sorting, and the "what was I doing?" — so your attention can go where it actually wants to go.

data.name: NdCard1Title
data.value: Catch it before it slips

data.name: NdCard1Body
data.value: Racing thought? Save it in seconds — no forms, no filing decisions. A captured thought is a thought off your mind.

data.name: NdCard2Title
data.value: One thing at a time

data.name: NdCard2Body
data.value: Today puts your current task front and center. Coming back after a distraction is one glance, not a scavenger hunt.

data.name: NdCard3Title
data.value: Structure that remembers for you

data.name: NdCard3Body
data.value: PARA gives everything one obvious home. No willpower-based filing systems, no twenty-folder decision trees.

data.name: NdCard4Title
data.value: Calm by design

data.name: NdCard4Body
data.value: A quiet, predictable interface with low cognitive load. Overdue is information, not punishment — no streaks, no guilt.

data.name: NdFooterNote
data.value: No shame mechanics. No noise. Just a system that meets your brain where it is — however it works.
